Name: Seasonal Witchy-Gothic Inspired Windows for CP and AT
Author: Mycenia
Description:
I adore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]Ali's[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/432]Witchy-Gothic Interior[/url]﻿ mod and the windows, in particular, are my favorite. Owning to my love of all things seasonal, I made edits to and variations of both the original windows, as well as two larger options of each. With Ali's kind permission, I'm offering them here. I haven't been doing this long. This is my first release. Be kind if you find an issue.  


[b]Features:

﻿For CP:[/b]
﻿Four windows, two singles and two doubles. 
﻿Optional dynamic seasonal changes or the choice of a static season, as well as the ability to disable the mod altogether. 
﻿Configuration options for each window. Only use the ones you want.

﻿[b]For AT:[/b] 
﻿Seasonal Options for both the Basic and Small Windows.

[b]Installation[/b]: 
﻿Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher/Alternative Textures. 
﻿Drop the contents of the zip file into your Mods folder. 
For Content Patcher version, run the game once to generate a config file. Default options are dynamic seasonal changes and all windows active.

[b]Take Note:[/b]
The windows may not look good with all wall textures. They will "clip" with many wainscoting textures, in particular.

﻿﻿Due to the nature of the larger windows, certain maps will start the game with half a window. If it is too distracting for you, you can turn that specific ﻿﻿window off in the configuration file until you are ready to purchase the other half. If you'd like to spawn them, the doubles utilize the Carved/Ornate and ﻿﻿Porthole/Metal windows, respectively. Alternatively (or additionally), use the Alternative textures version.

﻿﻿If the windows do not show up, there is likely another furniture mod overwriting them. The folder is names in such a way as to avoid this, if possible, but ﻿﻿Content Patcher packs that do not begin with "[CP]" could still be an issue.
﻿
﻿These windows were made for myself and, as such, the palette is mostly eemie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]map recolor﻿[/url]. It has with my own variation of fall, which won't match ﻿any one perfectly, but straddles a middle ground, of sorts. Those using Starblue Valley could easily swap spring and summer to get a better match in ﻿those seasons. Anyone interested in making personal edits, or edits they would like posted here with credit, can DM for the pdf file. 

[b]Credits: [/b]
Ali, for use of her base assets, linked above. 
﻿Willows are based on those in KAYA/jina2ya's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2030]Flower Valley[/url]
